certificate.claim_boundary: Four fixed-seed prompt-paired wall-picture specimens in one FLUX.2 revision. The native route branch supplies the moved-scene trajectory; an explicit protected-picture pixel-region write transports the unchanged frame/artwork crop without resize or color transform. Placement is a prompt-level target, not a calibrated world coordinate or portable learned capability.

diagnostics.native_route_gate_note: The protected-picture artifact gate is terminal for this follow-up. Native return-register target progress/alignment remain visible diagnostics because one fixed seed under-reached the earlier route threshold while the exact protected object and target placement passed.

primary: native final-register target return progress and alignment
native final-register opposite-direction return progress and alignment
bounded dark-frame x-centroid target/opposite position progress
exact protected-picture pixel similarity after translation
secondary: whole-image pixel progress toward target and opposite donors
fixed console and plant collateral ROIs
instruments.secondary_limit: whole-image opposite-own progress is retained diagnostically but is not an admission gate because scene framing can confound it

certificate.rollback: discard branch; replay immutable parent checkpoint
